An undertaker shows her new prodigy the ropes, in a world where humanity has stopped aging, has ceased natural death.

This game was created for the Neo-Twiny Jam 2026

Created using Inky. Reworked an old NYCMidnight challenge submission into suiting an interactive fiction structure. Wordcount total: 471 words
